facts.fact: 中文：KANDINSKY 向 Wacker 坦白自己正与一名同僚官员恋爱
facts.anchor: It’s about a relationship I’m in,” said KANDINSKY. “With a fellow officer.

facts.fact: 中文：KANDINSKY 说出恋爱对象就是 KRAY
中文：KANDINSKY 表示若 KRAY 求婚她会答应
facts.anchor: I plan to say yes,” said KANDINSKY

facts.fact: 中文：Wacker 告诉 KANDINSKY：KRAY 此前结过婚也离过婚
facts.anchor: did you know KRAY has been married and divorced before?

facts.fact: 中文：KANDINSKY 盯着 Wacker 衬衫背后的标签整整十秒
facts.anchor: She stared at the label on the back of his shirt for a full ten seconds.

facts.fact: 中文：KANDINSKY 拿起雨衣搭在手臂上走出办公室
facts.anchor: KANDINSKY picked up her raincoat, put it over her arm, and walked out.

facts.fact: 中文：Wacker 告诉 HR 的 EVERSHAG：KANDINSKY 想嫁给 KRAY
facts.anchor: KANDINSKY wants to marry KRAY,” said Wacker.

facts.fact: 中文：EVERSHAG 回应说 NOCs 总是充满惊喜
facts.anchor: “Like I told you NOCs are full of surprises,” said EVERSHAG.
